note: Release assets are downloaded into a cache and checksum-checked. They are not git objects. Raw footage, label files and user exports stay out. Player-ID and pose weights are excluded from v1 pending Legal. Entries with hosted=false have no URL yet; the script will not invent one.

assets.licence: MIT text in the upstream repo names the checkpoints; training-data licence is not stated in this repo
assets.training_data: Upstream describes a badminton shuttlecock set. This repo does not show Antony's matches or other users' footage in these files.
assets.consent: not applicable (public upstream checkpoint, not a Vamos user export)

assets.source: training scripts under tools/ball_tracker and tools/ball_track_v2 refer to local private clips
assets.licence: project code is AGPL-3.0-only; the weight file is not in git and has no published checksum
assets.training_data: The scripts name Antony's private match clips. Planned as a release asset only after he confirms a host URL and a checksum. Not included until then.
assets.consent: no other-user footage is described for this net

assets.training_data: No court weight file is in the repository. Court fitting in tree is classical geometry plus optional manual points.
The point-winner decoder is rules code, not a weight file. Per-match heads in opencourtvision/players/learned.py are fit on the user's own session and are not release assets.

excluded_v1_pending_legal.why: Player-ID weights are out of v1 pending Legal. MSMT17 is a research dataset of other people, not Vamos users. Commercial terms of those weights are unclear.
excluded_v1_pending_legal.consent: MSMT17 terms are research-only as recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES / player docs. Not a Vamos share opt-in.

excluded_v1_pending_legal.why: Pose weights are out of v1 pending Legal. Ultralytics ships YOLO under AGPL-3.0. Their docs, beyond the licence text, treat weights trained with their code as AGPL. The code import stays; the weight file is not a release asset.
Pose models are out of v1 pending Legal.
excluded_v1_pending_legal.consent: Apache-2.0 model card; not a Vamos user export

excluded_v1_pending_legal.why: Player detector weights are out of v1 pending Legal. Code licence is Apache-2.0. COCO images have mixed terms.
